description:
Approve or revoke an operator for an agent identity in the ERC-8004 identity registry. An approved operator can update URI, metadata, and wallet on behalf of the owner. Only the NFT owner can call this. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

approved.description: Grant approval (true) or revoke (false). Defaults to true.

fee.description: Fee preset ("low", "medium", "high") or micro-STX amount. Optional.

operator.description: Stacks address of the operator to approve or revoke

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

name: identity_set_approval
